method: Licensed symbolic score → LilyPond/MIDI → voice-aware performed event table; tuning estimated with librosa; Sync Toolbox 1.4.2 memory-restricted multiscale DTW at 50 frames/s, chroma + DLNCO. First/last attacks anchored by score-pitch energy rises in documented inspection windows; section anchors refined by DTW and checked against existing passage labels. Note-offs are warped notation, not measured key releases; final written holds extend to an estimated decay threshold. No aural review. See tools/align/REPORT.md. Additional internal score attacks are pinned by documented score-pitch energy windows; these are not independent listening annotations.
repeats: Bars 1-63 once in written order. The source has no repeat signs; nothing is cut or repeated.
